examples.name: Validation
examples.code:
<Form validationErrors={{username: 'Sorry, this username is taken.'}} maxWidth="size-3000">
  <TextField label="Username" name="username" />
</Form>

examples.name: Validation behavior
examples.code:
import {ButtonGroup, Button} from '@adobe/react-spectrum';

<Form validationBehavior="native" maxWidth="size-3000">
  <TextField label="Email" name="email" type="email" isRequired />
  <ButtonGroup>
    <Button type="submit" variant="primary">Submit</Button>
    <Button type="reset" variant="secondary">Reset</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
</Form>

examples.name: Focus management
Label position and alignment
examples.code:
<Form
  labelPosition="top"
  labelAlign="start"
  aria-label="Top position, start alignment example"
  maxWidth="size-3600">
  <TextField label="Name" />
  <RadioGroup label="Favorite pet">
    <Radio value="dogs">Dogs</Radio>
    <Radio value="cats">Cats</Radio>
  </RadioGroup>
</Form>
